_about: THE LINE OWNERS (T1259): FWA blue lines that belong to another water than the one FWA's watershed codes give them. Hand-authored, like name_variants.json (no program writes it); read by the atlas build (`graph.names.apply_line_owners`: the name-variant mechanism with validation: each piece takes the water's OWN best name tuple of `name`, carrying its gnis, at the same graph step; `check_line_owners` after the registry). Each entry: `blks`, `water` (where they go), `from` (whose they are today), `name`, `words` (what decided it). A line named here must not also be named in name_variants.json. Water flowing into an assigned line becomes the new water's tributary (the build prints those lines); the line's old water never does (`tributaries.AN_ASSIGNED_LINE_NEVER_LEADS_INTO_ITS_OLD_WATER`, checked by the reach run's `line_owner_gate`).
